FAQ.label: FAQ
FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know about programming and learning here.
FAQ.q1: I don't know anything about programming — can I still start?
FAQ.a1: That's exactly what we built this around. The diploma is designed from absolute zero — we assume you know nothing. In the very first lecture you'll understand what the internet is and what a website is, then we build on top of that step by step.
FAQ.a2: The diploma runs about 10 months. But what really matters isn't the duration — it's that you'll be building real projects and a GitHub & LinkedIn profile from day one. Companies look at work, not certificates.
FAQ.q3: What's the difference between this course and YouTube?
FAQ.a3: YouTube you watch and forget. Here every lecture has a task that gets graded and corrected, there's personal follow-up, and there's a leaderboard among your classmates. The difference is that here you're required to work — and that's what actually makes you learn.
FAQ.q4: Will someone follow up with me or am I on my own?
FAQ.a4: Not at all. Every task you submit reaches me personally — I correct it and give you real feedback. Not an automated message — an actual opinion on your work.
FAQ.q5: I'm scared I'll start and quit halfway — what will keep me going?
FAQ.a5: The system was built exactly for this. When you see your rank among classmates and watch your grades improve, you'll find yourself wanting to keep going. Real competition keeps people showing up.
FAQ.q6: Do I need an expensive laptop?
FAQ.a6: Any working laptop is completely fine. Programming doesn't need a powerful machine — it needs focus and effort.
FAQ.q7: Is English important? I'm weak at it.
FAQ.a7: Not really at all. All the explanations are in Arabic and you'll understand everything from day one. But you'll find that the terminology sinks into your head naturally over time without even noticing.

OurWork.label: Our Latest Work
OurWork.subtitle: When you finish the course you don't just get a certificate — you build real projects like these and add them to your GitHub & LinkedIn profile. This is just a small sample of what you'll be able to create.
OurWork.projectDesc: A full-scale order management system built with Next.js and MongoDB. Features include a real-time analytics dashboard, complete order lifecycle management (create, approve, reject, ship), advanced filtering and search, Excel and PDF export, and support for 1000+ orders. Clean professional UI focused on usability and performance.
